remarks: "Fabulous All Brick 3500 square foot Colonial on lovely and private culdesac 1/2 Acre lot. Welcoming 2-story foyer with marble floor, spacious and refined Living Room and large inviting formal Dining room with gorgeous hard wood floors for entertaining friends and family.  Striking & spacious Family room with cathedral ceiling and beautiful Stone Fireplace to relax, enjoy special times and grow memories, plus a 4-season Sunroom with Hot Tub.  The 2nd floor boasts 4 larger than usual Bedrooms including a lovely Primary Suite with its own private bathroom.  The warm Kitchen with beautiful Woodmode cabinetry has a roomy eating area and you will love the very spacious 1st floor Laundry.  A partially finished basement with outside entry adds endless possibilities for entertaining, working from home or playroom.  Step outside into  the  large 6-sided lot more play and entertaining.  Other amenities include wonderful wood floors, a generator,irrigation system, security system and did we mention "All Brick!"??  This  wonderful home is very conveniently located in the Williamsville School district and truly is a must see!  (Possible audio visual)"
